title: A resourceful state
header_line: My analysis of one book on habits. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What state are you in when you start your day?

I said that a state is a mode or condition of being, which I looked up in the dictionary. I said a negative thought pattern produces actions, then negative results, and you are no longer resourceful to yourself or others.
A student said: in a restaurant, a waiter in an impulsive, emotional state does not tap into their resources and does not control the outcome. I said: it is a domino effect.
I said that one little splinter in our thought process can derail our habits, behavior and state, like straw and a lit match.
A student said that resourcefulness means your internal resources, your best, not necessarily your most productive or happiest.
I said: picture two surfers caught in a big set. One thinks I am going to drown and panics. The other has been here before and knows exactly what to do. One acts from fear, the other from clarity.

I said you can say consciously: I am going to come at this from my most resourceful, clear state. I am not going to give in to wild emotions, fear or panic. We can take an inventory of our daily thoughts as well as habits.

I asked how a leader gets people around them into that zone, and suggested a two-minute thought habit with the team, with the psychology of why it matters. A student said: be the lighthouse, not the tugboat.
Another student said that it comes with being a good leader: if people trust you, they believe that if they follow you they will be better.
What is your most resourceful state like, and what brings you into it?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the state you are in most mornings.
Write what a resourceful state looks like for you.
Write what brings you into it.
Write a situation where panic cost you.
Write a two-minute thought habit for your team.

check.q: How did I define a state?
choices: A mode or condition of being

check.q: What did a student say a resourceful state means?
What did a student say to be as a leader?

recap: Notice your state. Come from clarity, not panic. Lead others into it.
